tasks.title: Run every tools/call through Runner.Call with result mapping and call logging
steps: Write TS-23-13 to 18 and TS-23-45 (TS-23-14 as a property test with testing/quick or a seeded generator over core.ToolResult incl. TextBlock/ThinkingBlock/ToolUseBlock) and confirm they fail
In mcpserve/call.go finish callTool: pass req.Params.Arguments bytes verbatim (empty when absent) to r.Call(ctx, name, input) exactly once; add no validation or preparation

Map the result: Content = [TextContent(res.LLMText())] followed by one TextContent per core.TextBlock in res.Blocks in order; drop other blocks; IsError = !res.OK; set no StructuredContent; never return a Go error
Use the request context so client cancellation and session end reach Runner.Call (result code `aborted`)
Do not serialise calls; unserved names are left to the SDK (protocol error, runner untouched)
After each call emit one Info record `tool call` with attributes tool, ok, duration and, on failure, the error code (attribute `error`); never log arguments, text or Detail

steps: Write TS-23-20 to 26 and TS-23-47 and confirm they fail; the child-process test (TS-23-21) re-executes the test binary via TestMain with a marker env var plus PATH/HOME and connects with mcp.Pool ServerConfig.Command; skip it on Windows

Run the SDK server session (Server.Connect + Wait, or Run); on ctx end close the session and os.Stdin and return ctx.Err(); on client EOF return nil after every owed reply is written; any other end returns an error prefixed `mcpserve: ` (e.g. wire-limit violation), the offending frame never reaching the SDK or runner

tasks.title: Implement ServeLoopback listener, authentication and body guard
steps: Write TS-23-4, 27 to 34 and 46 and confirm they fail; add package-level test seams in loopback.go (listen func and random reader vars) so listen/rand failures and `no listen when ctx done` are testable
Add mcpserve/endpoint.go: `type Endpoint struct{ URL, Token string; ... unexported close state }` with a Close method that for now shuts the http.Server down (task 5 makes it bounded and idempotent)

Add mcpserve/loopback.go: `(*Server).ServeLoopback(ctx) (*Endpoint, error)`: done ctx -> nil, ctx.Err() with no listen; listen tcp 127.0.0.1:0; token = 24 crypto/rand bytes as 48 lowercase hex; any failure releases the listener and returns `mcpserve: ...`

Build the handler chain: check `Authorization` against "Bearer "+token with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare on every path/method first -> 401, header `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer`, body `unauthorized`, before reading the body; then path != /mcp -> 404; then read the body through http.MaxBytesReader at wire.Defaults().MaxMessageBytes (over -> 413), wire.Guard(body, wire.Defaults()) failing -> 400, empty body passed through; replay the bytes as a fresh r.Body to sdk.NewStreamableHTTPHandler(func(*http.Request)*sdk.Server{return srv}, nil)
Serve with http.Server{ReadHeaderTimeout: 10s, BaseContext derived from ctx}; return &Endpoint{URL: "http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp", Token}
Log one Warn per refusal with `peer` (r.RemoteAddr) and a `reason` of distinct values for bad token, body too large, body rejected; never log the header value
Make the tests pass with -race
